title: A smooth reciprocal Bragg band cannot first-order follow a finite photon slope
statement: A differentiable nondegenerate scalar one-orbital reciprocal periodic band has E_int(q)=E_int(-q)=E_int(q+2pi), hence E_int_prime(pi)=0. If q_g(E0)=pi and q_g_prime(E0) is finite, first-order E_int(q_g(E))=E+O((E-E0)^2) would require0=1. This is a restricted single-band obstruction.

requires: Differentiable isolated nondegenerate one-orbital reciprocal periodic internal band and finite photon phase derivative at Bragg.
For the conditional off-Bragg construction, sin(q0)!=0,v finite nonzero and separately checked positive-band parameters.
provides: A differentiable nondegenerate scalar one-orbital reciprocal periodic band has E_int(q)=E_int(-q)=E_int(q+2pi), hence E_int_prime(pi)=0. If q_g(E0)=pi and q_g_prime(E0) is finite, first-order E_int(q_g(E))=E+O((E-E0)^2) would require0=1. This is a restricted single-band obstruction.
assumptions: Degenerate/multiband or frequency-dependent self-energy constructions are outside the no-go class.
Matching a local dispersion jet does not provide complete scattering, a global spectral gap or physical gate fidelity.
costs: Off-Bragg spacing, extra orbital modes or reactive controls change resources and need a complete bath/Maxwell calibration.

body: Evenness about pi follows by reciprocity and periodicity; differentiating proves zero slope. For off-Bragg q0 with sin(q0)!=0 and finite nonzero v=q_g_prime(E0), nearest-neighbor E_int=epsilon_bare+2J*cos(q) can match value and slope using J=-1/(2*sin(q0)*v),epsilon_bare=E0-2J*cos(q0). Positive bare band additionally requires epsilon_bare>2*|J|; it is not automatic. A two-orbital reciprocal crossing at pi also leaves the nondegenerate class. Neither bypass certifies the complete off-shell resolvent, all photon outputs, actual Maxwell guide or gate. The source reports a failed three-control Fano optimization with linearized phase and60 radiation outputs; its missing code/results prevent replay, and that tested failure is not a global impossibility theorem.

evidence.quote: The off-Bragg single-band matching is not a gate theorem. I computed the genuine finite-band self-energy of a declared Fano-Anderson array, including its real principal-value matrix and **all 60 unwanted angular output channels**, with two guided propagation columns and a frequency-dependent positive bath spectrum. One-channel coherent input error is calculated from the full normalized final state, not postselected transmitted photons. The model uses phase functions q_g(E)=q0+q'_g(E0)(E−E0), θ_rad(E)=θ0 E/E0; it has NOT acquired the full Maxwell dyadic for a finite-cross-section guide.
